# Two NASDAQ:AMZN prices in USD on two days in Toronto and on one day in UTC.
#
# The first is at 2026-01-06 04:59:59 UTC, which is 23:59:59 on 2026-01-05 in
# Toronto, the time GnuCash 5.x's stock transaction assistant gives a price.
# The second is at 2026-01-06 10:59:00 UTC, the time GnuCash's Price Editor
# gives a date (Q-041, table 2). In Toronto each is on a day of its own; in UTC
# both are on 2026-01-06.
#
# What this fixture produces, imported under TZ=America/Toronto: a book holding
# both prices.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_block_that_moves_no_price_is_not_checked_for_its_day.py.
2026-01-01 commodity AMZN
	mnemonic: "AMZN"
	fullname: "Amazon.com Inc"
	namespace: "NASDAQ"
	fraction: 10000

price
	guid: "6d1e5a4f2b3c4d5e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a"
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	time: "2026-01-06 04:59:59 +0000"
	value: "21500/100"
	source: "Finance::Quote"
	type: "last"

price
	guid: "7e2f6b5a3c4d5e6f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b"
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	time: "2026-01-06 10:59:00 +0000"
	value: "21700/100"
	source: "Finance::Quote"
	type: "last"
